name: Seerr

lifecycle.note: Active upstream; v3.5.0 is the current stable release and Seerr remains the successor to Jellyseerr and Overseerr.

security: Keep media-server credentials and Sonarr/Radarr API keys in secret storage; scope public access separately.
pitfalls: The first-run flow needs owner-selected media-server credentials, libraries, and Sonarr/Radarr endpoints and API keys; use service DNS rather than localhost between containers.
Back up existing Overseerr/Jellyseerr data before first start because migration is automatic and forward-only.
